Feature/: [Wplay-Desktop-Windows] - [] - When clicking on the channel player to pause playback, the pause icon is displayed in the interface, but the video continues playing without stopping the audio or image..


Details= 

Actual Behavior:
The playback does not stop and the media continues running.


Expected Behavior:
The video playback stops and no media continues playing.


Given a video is currently playing on the channel player
When the user triggers the stop action
Then the player should stop immediately,
